headline: Oil breaks above $100; Hang Seng closes down 0.66% on Wednesday
summary: Brent crude briefly broke above $100 per barrel on Wednesday, September 9, amid escalating US-Iran conflict. Focus has shifted to whether shipping disruption will be prolonged.
why: Brent is the main global benchmark for crude oil, and Middle East supply and shipping routes strongly influence its price and inflation expectations.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Escalating US-Iran conflict and possible shipping disruption push up expected supply risk for crude oil.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Escalating US-Iran conflict lifted Brent above $100 a barrel. Investors are focused on whether shipping disruption lasts, which would keep oil and inflation pressure elevated.
